news.title: Wall art and lots that never close
news.body: Eight Smoky Hollow paintings are in the buy catalog under Decorative: Davy Crockett, Devil Anse Hatfield, Randolph McCoy, Billy the Kid, Daniel Boone, old maps of Tennessee and North Carolina, and a Smokies sunset. Store and skill lots now stay open around the clock. Linux players can join in too. Press UPDATE in the launcher to get it.

news.title: Skill together, skill faster
news.body: Skill speeds now match the classic feel: about 149% skilling alone at a skill house, and every friend who joins speeds everyone up. Press UPDATE in the launcher to get it, along with a new start screen and safer logins.

news.title: Smoky Hollow is on the Mac
news.body: Mac neighbors can grab the launcher from the website's Trading Post. It works on Apple-chip and Intel Macs.

news.title: Smoky Hollow opens for testing
news.body: The first homestead is up on Grindstone Oasis and the jam stand is paying out.

news.title: Neighbors
news.body: Our first testers are moving in soon. Plenty of room by the creek.
